title: Operating Lines of Credit: AutoDraft Enrolment and the Enrolment-Day Contract Rate
content:
When a member authorises AutoDraft on one of their Operating Lines of Credit, the contract rate of the line is set again on the enrolment day.

## Rule

When a member authorises AutoDraft on an operating line in active, suspended or matured status, the contract rate is set again on the enrolment day, effective that day.

The contract rate set when AutoDraft is enrolled is fixed only after the records carry a late charge on the line's latest interest bill whenever that bill is still unpaid after its grace period.

## Business effect

From the enrolment day each interest bill on the line is debited on its due date from the checking account the member names. The line then shows AutoDraft enrolled, the last four digits of the debited account and the contract rate set on the enrolment day, in force from that day.

## Platform reference: `enroll_autodraft_36bd3fb2`

**Capability.** The member authorises AutoDraft on one of their own operating lines. One call switches AutoDraft on for the line, records the last four digits of the account to be debited and puts the stated contract rate in force on the line from today.

**How it is invoked.** This is the member's own tool. The servicing representative unlocks `enroll_autodraft_36bd3fb2` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, since AutoDraft rests on the member's own authorisation.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `line_id` | Loan number of the member's operating line AutoDraft is set up on, as the servicing representative reads it out from the member's operating lines | Identifier |
| `account_last4` | Last four digits of the member's checking account to be debited, as the member states them | 4 digits; never empty on an enrolment |
| `interest_rate` | The contract rate in force from the enrolment | Annual percentage rate, 3 decimal places (for example 8.375), rounded half up to 3 decimal places before it is passed |

**Return.** A receipt rendered as text with `line_id` (the line enrolled), `autodraft_enrolled` (the boolean true), `autodraft_account_last4` (the 4 digits recorded), `interest_rate` (the annual percentage rate now in force, 3 decimal places), `effective_date` (today's date, in year-month-day form) and `status`, the literal "enrolled", meaning AutoDraft is on for the line.

## Contract questions

**From when does the new rate run?** From today, the enrolment day.

**What does the member see on the line afterwards?** AutoDraft shown as enrolled, the account digits and the new contract rate.
